bedLength.subtitle: Optional. Most mattresses are 200 cm long; some are 190 cm.

bedFabric.subtitle: Optional. The fabric that covers the upholstered bed.

wardrobeInterior.subtitle: Optional. Pick everything you'd use. If you're not sure, the company will suggest a layout.

basinType.subtitle: Optional. The company builds the top and the unit around the basin. If you're not sure, pick "Not sure".

basinSupply.subtitle: Optional. So the company knows whether to include it in the offer.

hallWidth.subtitle: Optional. It helps the company choose how deep the pieces should be.

washerLoading.subtitle: Optional. It changes how the cabinet around it is built.
